title: Core valuation-ring properties for a finite p-adic extension
statement: The valuation ring and maximal ideal in the first fourteen clauses of [lem-weil-l-adic-extension-integers-dvr] exist with all displayed ring, DVR, fraction-field and finite-residue properties, through the existence of a generator of the maximal ideal.

proof.text: Apply the proper finite-dimensional valued-field criterion and identify the integer and maximal-ideal predicates with the absolute-value inequalities; the standard proper-valued-field theorem supplies the DVR and finite residue field, and elementary unit and fraction-field arguments supply the remaining displayed clauses.

lean.statement: theorem extension_integers_dvr_core (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (abv : AbsoluteValue E ℝ) (h_ext : ∀ a : ℚ_[l], abv (algebraMap ℚ_[l] E a) = ‖a‖) : ∃ O : Subring E, ∃ m : Ideal O, (∀ x : E, x ∈ O ↔ abv x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x : O, x ∈ m ↔ abv (x : E) < 1) ∧ (∀ x : O, IsUnit x ↔ abv (x : E) = 1) ∧ IsLocalRing O ∧ m.IsMaximal ∧ (∀ J : Ideal O, J.IsMaximal → J = m) ∧ IsFractionRing O E ∧ IsDiscreteValuationRing O ∧ IsPrincipalIdealRing O ∧ m ≠ ⊥ ∧ (∀ J : Ideal O, J.IsPrime ∧ J ≠ ⊥ ↔ J = m) ∧ Finite (O ⧸ m) ∧ (∃ r : ℝ, (∃ y : O, y ∈ m ∧ y ≠ 0 ∧ abv (y : E) = r) ∧ (∀ y : O, y ∈ m → y ≠ 0 → abv (y : E) ≤ r) ∧ (∀ π : O, Ideal.span ({π} : Set O) = m ↔ π ≠ 0 ∧ abv (π : E) = r)) ∧ (∃ π : O, Ideal.span ({π} : Set O) = m)
